description: Sterling, Raymond and colleagues publish this resource through the native repository. The report and attached archive document detailed simulation models for Aztarain, Areilza (the surgical block) and Gurtubay in the Basurto complex. Their object is building-side demand within a district-cooling system. A related INDIGO virtual-testbed paper describes model-predictive-control testing with FMI co-simulation and model exchange; it is grouped as companion test infrastructure without asserting identical code or periods. The description does not identify every model parameter or make the building measurements publicly available. Consumption-side validation settings are retained in the separate verification case. Zenodo publishes the record with open access and a native licence label of cc-by-sa-4.0. Source metadata and file descriptors were inspected; no linked files, model archives, code or documentation bodies were opened. Coverage and validation are limited to the stated model, data or application. Publication date does not establish current software maintenance.
